name: 靠左標題文字段＋右下角數據框
desc: 靠左的標題、說明段落與文字連結，右下角放一個小型數據框，框的右緣延伸到畫面右側附近；手機版數據框移到最上方。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左側是一段靠左對齊的文字，左緣對齊頁面內容寬度，約佔畫面寬的三分之二：標題（可多行）在上，大小和一般區塊標題同級，不是主視覺級的大字：字高約為說明文字的三倍，一行短標題約佔畫面寬的一半，不會橫跨整個文字欄；標題下方是說明文字，最下方可放一個附小圖示、帶底線的文字連結，沒有時省略。右側靠下放一個有底色的小型數據框，寬度約佔畫面寬的五分之一，明顯小於文字欄；框的底邊和左側文字欄的底部大致同高，框的右緣超出頁面內容寬度，延伸到接近畫面右緣處（右側仍留一點邊）。數據框內上方是一行小標籤，旁邊可放一個小圖示，中間靠右是一個大數字加單位，下方靠右可放一行次要文字，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：數據框移到區塊最上方，橫跨頁面內容寬度，框內改為左右排列，小標籤與次要文字在左、大數字在右；下方依序是標題（可多行，維持一般區塊標題的大小，約為說明文字的兩倍多）、說明文字與文字連結，皆靠左。

en.name: Left-aligned title text + stat box at bottom right
en.desc: A left-aligned title, description and text link, with a small stat box at the bottom right whose right edge extends close to the viewport edge; on mobile the stat box moves to the top.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. On the left is a left-aligned block of text whose left edge aligns with the page content width, taking up about two thirds of the viewport width: a title (may wrap to multiple lines) on top, sized like an ordinary section title rather than hero-scale display text: its letters are about three times the height of the description text, and a short one-line title takes up about half the viewport width, not spanning the whole text column; below the title is a description, and optionally a text link with a small icon and an underline at the bottom; omit it when there is no content. On the right, at the bottom, place a small stat box with a background fill, about one fifth of the viewport width and clearly smaller than the text column; its bottom edge is roughly level with the bottom of the text column, and its right edge extends beyond the page content width to close to the right edge of the viewport (keeping a small margin on the right). Inside the stat box, a single label sits at the top, optionally with a small icon beside it; in the middle, aligned right, is a large number with a unit; below it, aligned right, is optional secondary text; omit it when there is no content.
en.mobile: Switches to a vertical stack: the stat box moves to the top of the section, spanning the page content width, and its contents are arranged side by side, with the label and secondary text on the left and the large number on the right; below it come the title (may wrap to multiple lines, still sized like an ordinary section title, a little over twice the size of the description text), the description and the text link, all aligned left.
